description:
Hit while adding fz-5xp.17's allocation golden.

A fixture with no per-door goldens compares every door against expected.txt, and
BLESS writes every door TO expected.txt. When the doors disagree -- which any
allocation golden does, because interp and the native doors allocate
differently -- each door overwrites the last, and the file ends up holding
whichever door blessed last.

    BLESS=1 cargo test --test fixture_matrix json_decode_cost
      interp ... ok      <- wrote its numbers to expected.txt
      run    ... ok      <- overwrote them with its own
      build  ... ok
      3 passed

    cargo test --test fixture_matrix json_decode_cost
      interp ... FAILED

BLESS reports ok because it is writing, not comparing, so the run that creates
the problem looks like the run that solves it. The fix is by hand: create
<name>.expected.<door>.txt for the door that differs, after which bless targets
the per-door file correctly (check_success picks path_expected_path when it
EXISTS).

WHAT IT SHOULD DO: when a bless would overwrite an expected.txt that another
door in the same run already wrote with different content, write the per-door
file instead -- the harness knows both facts at that moment. Failing that, it
must at least refuse rather than report ok.

Cheap and worth it: the failure mode is a fixture that passes when blessed and
fails in CI, which is the most expensive kind.
title: BLESS on a fixture whose doors disagree writes goldens that then fail
